ex.s: These specialists could work at the office until ten each night, then look back and realize they would have loved to have gone home and enjoyed the sweetness of their family and friends, or traveled to exciting places, meeting interesting people.

ex.s: They kept their collection at home until it got too big     37     until they died, and then it was given to a museum.

ex.s: Or perhaps a design works so well it is adopted elsewhere again and again, with seemingly harmless improvements, until, suddenly, it does not work at all anymore.

ex.s: If you don't understand the answer to a question, ask the doctor to explain it again until you do understand.
ex.src: 2020全国新高考II卷·Talking with your doctor
